# Log policy CSS CDN cache release fix (2026-09-23)

- Base: homepage `main@675871f3eb93a69bcb81d0b0213f9c68f7ed2a45`. Cloudflare's production build succeeded for the typography hotfix, and KO/JA/EN HTML matched its build, but the unversioned public `/styles-log-policy.css` still returned the older SHA-256 `dcec105b94103fc9a8d580bbc7b136c61af9b817e287db426811ee4146dfca8e`. The identical path with a new query returned the correct hotfix SHA `e176a37f7a6f13fb0adc13bd21fb5cd166faadc29a4cb45680f37e52369f120d`. The HTML and CSS were therefore inconsistent at the public URL; Cloudflare check success alone was not enough to call the pixel fix live.
- Fix: all four Log privacy routes reference `/styles-log-policy.css?v=e176a37f7a6f`. A test computes the actual CSS file's SHA prefix and fails if any route points to an older cache key. No policy wording or CSS pixels changed in this PR.
- Exact static build: 133 pages; KO HTML `4ac3b7a14ab222a442d49c87b78685842e3e6e41aef56de1360790ebdded7a53`, JA `e0a7c646dda62d5e3ee113df374d26be218c23825cdf7b73ce92a247927ecb50`, EN `85244616692871631a7a74bf8b1233f8317c55184967608d1940135afe7d58c0`, default `b7f17e78b7f2f54766d7ebd46c5e4e75cd0ad99b7f5325b099074dc9032f3229`; CSS `e176a37f7a6f13fb0adc13bd21fb5cd166faadc29a4cb45680f37e52369f120d`.
- Browser: exact built KO/JA/EN at 320 CSS px, 200% text, light theme all returned HTTP 200, loaded the versioned stylesheet, rendered the expected computed KO `word-break: keep-all`, JA `line-break: strict` and first-column `word-break: keep-all`, EN first-column `overflow-wrap: normal`, and had 0 document horizontal overflow. [KO](ko-320-200.png) · [JA](ja-320-200.png) · [EN](en-320-200.png). The full typography before/after visual matrix remains in [the hotfix report](../hotfix/DESIGN-QA.md); this PR only changes the CSS URL, not pixels.
- Checks: `npm test` 133/133 PASS; `npm run build` PASS; `npm run test:built` PASS; `git diff --check` PASS. UI release remains **unverified** until independent source review, main merge, Cloudflare production success, and public HTML + versioned CSS SHA readback.
